rows.text: Water has reached the first floor and my grandmother cannot climb down
rows.label: rescue_needed

rows.text: Help! Our car is floating in the water near the nala
rows.label: rescue_needed

rows.text: Kids stuck inside the school building, water rising fast
rows.label: rescue_needed

rows.text: నీటిలో చిక్కుకుపోయాం, త్వరగా రండి
rows.label: rescue_needed

rows.text: మా కాలనీలో ఇళ్ళు మునిగిపోతున్నాయి, ప్రజలను బయటకు తీయండి
rows.label: rescue_needed

rows.text: पानी गले तक आ गया है, कोई हमें निकालो
rows.label: rescue_needed

rows.text: हमारी गली में लोग पानी में फंसे हैं
rows.label: rescue_needed

rows.text: پانی گھر میں آ گیا ہے، ہمیں نکالیں
rows.label: rescue_needed

rows.text: Old man collapsed and is not breathing properly
rows.label: medical

rows.text: My son got a deep cut from debris, need a doctor
rows.label: medical

rows.text: ఒక మహిళకు ప్రసవ నొప్పులు, ఆసుపత్రికి తీసుకెళ్లాలి
rows.label: medical

rows.text: बुज़ुर्ग को दिल का दौरा पड़ा है
rows.label: medical

rows.text: किसी को सांप ने काट लिया है
rows.label: medical

rows.text: میرے والد بے ہوش ہو گئے ہیں
rows.label: medical

rows.text: Wires hanging low over the flooded lane, could electrocute someone
rows.label: power_hazard

rows.text: Our compound gate is giving shocks
rows.label: power_hazard

rows.text: స్తంభం విరిగి వైర్లు నీటిలో ఉన్నాయి
rows.label: power_hazard

rows.text: खंभे से तार टूटकर सड़क पर पड़ा है
rows.label: power_hazard

rows.text: घर की दीवार में करंट आ रहा है
rows.label: power_hazard

rows.text: کھمبا گر گیا ہے اور تاریں پانی میں ہیں
rows.label: power_hazard

rows.text: Bridge approach washed out, traffic stopped
rows.label: road_blocked

rows.text: Railway underbridge flooded, buses turned back
rows.label: road_blocked

rows.text: ఫ్లైఓవర్ కింద నీళ్ళు నిలిచిపోయాయి, ట్రాఫిక్ జామ్
rows.label: road_blocked

rows.text: मुख्य मार्ग पर घुटनों तक पानी है, वाहन नहीं जा रहे
rows.label: road_blocked

rows.text: سڑک پر درخت گر گیا ہے، ٹریفک رکا ہوا ہے
rows.label: road_blocked

rows.text: Manhole open on the flooded road, very dangerous for vehicles
rows.label: road_blocked

rows.text: Is there any relief camp near the stadium?
rows.label: info_request

rows.text: Will there be a power cut tonight?
rows.label: info_request

rows.text: Which roads are safe to reach the airport?
rows.label: info_request

rows.text: సహాయ శిబిరం ఎక్కడ పెట్టారు?
rows.label: info_request

rows.text: क्या कल दफ्तर खुले रहेंगे?
rows.label: info_request

rows.text: کیا کل اسکول بند رہیں گے؟
rows.label: info_request
